title: The Elephant's Child
summary: A curious young animal leaves home to find answers and starts a strange river adventure.
coverScene: A young elephant stands by a green river while another animal watches closely.

sentences.text: Long ago, animals of that kind had no long nose parts, only small ones.
One young animal was full of interest and asked many questions.
He asked questions about everything that he saw in the world.
The other people of the group were tired of him because he spoke too much.
He spoke too much every day, and his family members did not like his habit.
They wanted him to stop speaking, but he could not stop his mind from thinking about things.
He always wanted to know more about the world, and every single moment was a chance to ask something new.
His friends tried to ignore him, and they walked away when he came close.
Still, he did not care about their mind and soul.
He kept asking questions from morning until night, but no one could give him a good answer.
He felt that he must find out the truth because his mind was never quiet.
He wanted to understand how everything worked, while the other creatures were very sad with him.
They hoped that he would find a new interest soon.
He always thought about the future and what he might learn next.
His parents told him to be quiet, but he did not listen to them.
Many days passed, and his questions never stopped growing.
Every animal in the group felt that he was too difficult.
They did not want to hear his voice anymore.
He wondered why nobody would answer his great questions.
One day, he asked a very special question about what the large water animal ate for dinner.
None of the other creatures could give him a good answer.
Full of interest, he decided to travel to find out for himself.
He walked away from home until he reached the great river, which was long and wide.
He walked for many days to reach that place, and the journey was difficult and long.
He felt tired, but he did not stop because he wanted to find the answer.
When he arrived at the river, he looked everywhere for the water animal.
The water animal lived in the water and waited quietly for food.
When the young animal asked his question, the water animal told him to come closer.
Suddenly, the water animal caught his little nose part and pulled very hard.
A long pull started between the small animal and the large river creature.
While they pulled against each other, his nose part stretched and stretched.
It became a long form after they pulled for a long time.
Finally, the young animal was able to pull away and escape back home.
He ran as fast as he could, and his heart beat fast with fear.
He was glad to be free again.
He felt the pain in his nose while he ran through the forest.
The water animal watched him leave and went back into the deep water.
The journey home was long, but he did not stop for anything.
At first, his new long nose part felt very strange to him.
However, he soon realized that it was useful for everyday life.
He could use it for eating food, drinking water, and moving away bad animals.
When he returned home, all the other animals saw his new feature and wanted one too.
They looked at him with great surprise, and they could not believe their eyes.
His mother and father were also shocked, and they asked him how his nose part became so long.
He told them the whole story about the river and the water animal.
Then, the other animals decided to make the same journey, and they walked to the great river one by one.
They wanted to get long nose parts of their own.
When they met the water animal, the same thing happened to them.
They all came back home with long nose parts too.
From that day on, every animal of that kind had a long nose part.
They lived happily and used their new features every day.
The young animal was finally happy because he had found his answer.
He never stopped asking questions, though, and he always found new things to learn.
His life was full of adventure from that time forward.
The other creatures were happy with their new noses as well.
They used their long parts to reach food in high places.
Everything was peaceful in the group, and no one complained anymore.
The young animal continued to ask questions for the rest of his days.

sentences.text: In a time when the world was still learning its own shapes, the creatures of that kind possessed no elongated snout, but merely a small and unremarkable protuberance where a nose should be.
Among them lived a young creature whose mind was utterly consumed by an insatiable curiosity, questioning the very fabric of existence.
Scarcely a moment passed without him posing yet another inquiry about the mechanisms of the world, probing deeply into matters that others preferred to leave undisturbed.
His incessant voice grated upon the patience of his extended family, who found his relentless interrogation wearing upon their daily peace.
They longed for him to lapse into silence, yet his intellect refused to remain dormant, driven as it was by a profound need to comprehend the universe.
Not a single member of his herd could tolerate his presence for long, choosing instead to slip away whenever his familiar footsteps approached.
He remained entirely unperturbed by their cold indifference, marching resolutely to the rhythm of his own relentless thoughts.
From the first light of dawn until the deep shadows of dusk, he bombarded anyone who would listen with questions that defied easy answers.
No one possessed the wisdom to satisfy his cravings for truth, leaving him to wander the plains with a mind that burned like a restless fire.
While his companions despaired of his eccentricities, hoping quietly that he might outgrow his burdensome obsession, he looked perpetually toward the horizon.
His parents offered stern warnings, urging him to moderate his tone and conform to the quiet dignity expected of their kind.
Yet their admonitions drifted past him like the dry savanna wind, leaving no lasting impression upon his fiercely independent spirit.
As days accumulated into weeks, the volume and complexity of his inquiries only escalated, pushing his community to the absolute brink of endurance.
Every single creature in the group regarded him as an exhausting burden, wishing desperately that they might never hear his voice again.
He could not fathom why profound questions were met with such hostility, wondering endlessly why the world was populated by minds so stubbornly closed.
The pivotal moment arrived on a humid morning when he posed a query so specific and unprecedented that even the oldest elders fell completely silent.
He demanded to know, with absolute precision, what the great bi-colored-python-rock-snake consumed for its evening meal.
Not a single soul in the surrounding territory could furnish a satisfactory reply, leaving him suspended in a vacuum of ignorance.
Driven by an intense compulsion that brooked no denial, he resolved to undertake a perilous expedition to uncover the truth himself.
He turned his back upon the familiar paths of home, setting his course toward the distant, winding river where the mysterious creature was rumored to dwell.
He walked for numerous days across harsh and unforgiving terrain, his physical strength waning under the relentless heat of the midday sun.
Fatigue gnawed at his muscles, yet his burning curiosity acted as an invisible shield against complete exhaustion.
When he finally crested the muddy banks of the great river, the water stretched out before him like a broad, sluggish mirror of slate.
He scoured the reedy shallows with his eyes, searching for any sign of the elusive reptile that waited silently in the muddy depths.
Spotted at last near the riverbank, the creature raised its heavy head, advising him with a sinister hiss to step much closer.
Without a second thought, the young adventurer stepped forward, leaning down to repeat his forbidden question about the evening meal.
In a flash of deceptive speed, the large reptile lunged forward and clamped its powerful jaws firmly around his tiny, unassuming nose.
A fierce and desperate struggle ensued right there on the muddy bank, transforming the quiet river edge into a battlefield of raw tension.
As the snake pulled downstream with immense force and the young creature braced his feet against the soil, a remarkable transformation began.
Under the strain of that monumental tug-of-war, his little nose stretched and elongated, pulling outward like elastic under stress.
The struggle continued until the skin and muscle had been drawn out to an astonishing length, defying all natural precedent.
With a sudden, violent wrench, the young animal managed to tear himself free from the reptile's crushing grip.
He scrambled backward up the bank, his heart hammering wildly against his ribs as adrenaline flooded his trembling veins.
The great river creature watched him retreat with cold indifference before sinking slowly back into the murky depths.
Pain burned fiercely through his newly transformed facial feature, yet gratitude for his escape propelled him forward without a pause.
The long journey home was undertaken in a haze of shock and physical discomfort, with every step accompanied by the strange sensation of his altered face.
He wrapped his elongated nose around low branches to steady himself, discovering quite by accident that the appendage possessed unexpected utility.
When he finally limped back into the clearing of his home community, the gathered animals stopped dead in their tracks.
They stared at him with wide, unblinking eyes, utterly paralyzed by astonishment at the bizarre apparition standing before them.
His parents stared in horror and disbelief, demanding to know what catastrophic accident had transformed his features beyond all recognition.
He recounted every detail of his perilous journey to the great river and his dramatic encounter with the river serpent.
As they listened to the tale of utility and adaptation, a wave of thoughtful consideration rippled through the skeptical crowd.
One by one, driven by a sudden envy of his newfound capability, the other members of the herd decided to retrace his steps.
They packed into single file and marched away toward the distant river, determined to secure long noses of their own.
When each of them finally confronted the reptile in the shallows, the exact same dramatic stretching occurred.
They returned to the community trailing identical elongated appendages, completely altering the physical identity of their entire species.
From that eventful day onward, no member of the herd possessed a short face, and their daily existence was revolutionized.
The young adventurer felt a profound sense of vindication, knowing that his reckless curiosity had permanently bettered his kind.
He never ceased his habit of asking questions, continuing to probe the mysteries of the world with unwavering persistence.
Peace settled over the herd as they utilized their new instruments to reach high foliage and navigate their environment with ease.
Life in the savanna assumed a harmonious rhythm, entirely devoid of the previous complaints and petty arguments.
The young creature lived out his days surrounded by peers who now respected his inquisitive mind rather than shunning it.
Every single sunrise brought new opportunities for exploration, and he seized them all with characteristic enthusiasm.
His elongated nose served him faithfully in every imaginable endeavor, proving that the pursuit of truth carries tangible rewards.
And so he remained forever curious, asking the universe questions until the very end of his extraordinary life.
